🚨 A 41-year-old father died in ICE custody They lied and said he died at the hospital. Now, phone recordings TELL THE TRURH about this fathers life and the intolerable crimes in these detention centers. 

When someone dies while detained by the government, their family deserves answers—and the public deserves transparency.

This story concerns the death of Edwin López-Cornejo, a Salvadoran father who died after a medical emergency while in ICE custody at Delaney Hall in Newark, New Jersey. His family raised concerns about access to essential medication and the medical attention he received before his death. Federal officials gave a different account of his care.

📞 **What do the phone recordings reveal?** In this video, we examine the evidence, the conflicting accounts, and the questions that demand answers.

⚖️ **Government custody comes with responsibility.** When a person dies in detention, transparency, independent scrutiny, and accountability matter.
